title: Work and Energy
subtitle: Understanding the physical concepts of work, energy, and power
subject: Science
author: Shine Academy
learning_outcomes: Understand the scientific conception of work.
Calculate work done by a constant force.
Define energy and state its units.
Derive equations for kinetic and potential energy.
Understand the law of conservation of energy.
Calculate power and commercial units of energy.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the principles of work, energy, conservation of energy, and power with real-world applications.
common_misconceptions: Work is done when a person holds a heavy weight without moving (No, displacement is required)
Energy can be created or destroyed (No, it can only be transformed)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Focus heavily on the conditions required for work to be done (force and displacement in the same direction) and the transformation of energy.
